name: clean-code-v12
description: Squiggles, hovers, and quick-fixes from the Clean Code V12 linter (cc-lsp).

cleanCodeV12.cli.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `cc` CLI binary. The extension will try `<cli.path>` with the `lsp` subcommand first; if that fails it falls back to spawning `cc-lsp` (the standalone LSP daemon binary). Either binary must be on `PATH`, or this setting must point at the binary directly.

cleanCodeV12.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to the standalone `cc-lsp` daemon binary (used when the `cc lsp` subcommand is unavailable). Defaults to `cc-lsp` which must be on `PATH`.

cleanCodeV12.severity.markdownDescription: Minimum finding severity surfaced as a diagnostic. Mirrors the `--severity` flag on `cc check`.

cleanCodeV12.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the cc-lsp server.
